questions.question: According to the test trials conducted in May 2026, what is the **Circular Error Probable (CEP)** achieved by the **300 km range rockets** of the **Suryastra Universal Rocket Launcher** system?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2.0 meters**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Pune-based defence firm **Nibe Limited** successfully conducted test-firing trials of the **Suryastra Universal Rocket Launcher system** on **May 18 and 19, 2026**.
 
• The trials were held at the **Interim Test Range (ITR)** in **Chandipur, Odisha**, meeting all mission objectives with precision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Circular Error Probable (CEP):** This is a key metric used to measure the accuracy of a munition, representing the radius within which 50% of the rounds are expected to land.
 
• **High Precision:** The **300 km range rockets** of the Suryastra system recorded an incredibly low **CEP of just 2.0 meters**.
 
• **Comparison:** The **150 km range rockets** achieved an even tighter precision with a **CEP of 1.5 meters**.
 
• **Strategic Significance:** Achieving a CEP of under two meters at a distance of 300 km makes the **Suryastra** one of the most accurate long-range rocket artillery systems globally, enabling the neutralization of high-value targets with minimal collateral damage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The system was developed under the **Indian Army's Emergency Procurement** window, with the contract awarded in **January 2026**.
 
• The **Suryastra** rockets are **Precise & Universal Launching System (PULS)** rockets originally designed by **Israeli Elbit Systems** and are set to be manufactured in India by **Nibe Group**.
 
• This indigenous manufacturing boost bridges the operational gap between traditional field artillery and heavy ballistic missiles.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The **Suryastra** provides the **Indian Army** with a **flexible, rapid-response, and cost-effective** weapon system for the modern battlefield.
 
• The trials validated the system's performance across **short, medium, and long distances**.

questions.question: Which city is the host for the 68th Session of the Asian Productivity Organization (APO) Governing Body being held in May 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

__
 
• The Government of India is hosting the **68th Session of the Asian Productivity Organization (APO) Governing Body** from **20 to 22 May 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The **68th Session** of the APO Governing Body (GBM) is being held at **Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi**.
 
• The event is being chaired by **India**, following the decision announced during the 67th Session in May 2025.
 
• The inaugural session on **21 May 2026** is scheduled to be attended by the Union Minister for Commerce and Industry, **Shri Piyush Goyal**.
 
• The session brings together over **60 senior delegates** representing **20 APO member economies**, along with observers from **Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Bhutan**, and the **Global Green Growth Institute**.
 
• The Governing Body is the **highest decision-making body** of the APO, serving as the apex forum for governance and strategic oversight.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• It currently comprises **21 member economies** from the Asia-Pacific region.
 
• **Shri Amardeep Singh Bhatia**, Secretary of the **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)**, assumed the Chairmanship of the APO Governing Body at the 67th Session in 2025.
 
• The APO focuses on enhancing productivity for **sustainable socioeconomic development** through mutual cooperation and knowledge sharing.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The meeting will also review the **APO Secretary-General election procedures** and confer **APO National Awards** for Productivity Advocates and Technical Experts.
 
• Hosting this session reflects India's commitment to **productivity-led growth**, innovation, and sustainable development in the region.

questions.question: During the state visit of President Nikos Christodoulides in May 2026, India and Cyprus agreed to establish a roadmap for bilateral defence cooperation covering which of the following periods?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2026 – 2031**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India and **Cyprus** elevated their bilateral relationship to a **strategic partnership** during the state visit of Cypriot President **Nikos Christodoulides** to New Delhi in **May 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The two nations agreed on a **roadmap for bilateral defence cooperation** specifically for the period **2026 to 2031**.
 
• This roadmap aims to deepen cooperation in strategic sectors, focusing on **capacity building**, technical cooperation, and partnerships between **Indian private and public sector firms** with Cypriot defence companies.
 
• This is the third defence-related announcement since **2022**, following initial agreements signed during External Affairs Minister **S. Jaishankar’s** visit in 2022 and **PM Modi’s** visit in 2025.
 
• Other significant outcomes include the establishment of a **joint working group on counter-terrorism**, a **cyber security dialogue**, and a **consular dialogue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **EU SAFE Programme:** Cyprus has been allocated **$1.5 billion** under the European Union's **$150 billion SAFE** programme, which provides opportunities for Indian defence firms to partner with EU companies.
 
• **Connectivity:** Cyprus is keen to join the **India–Middle East–Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)** to serve as a key connectivity partner for India to enter the European market.
 
• **Free Trade Agreement (FTA):** Under the Cypriot presidency of the Council of the EU, negotiations for the **India-EU FTA** have concluded, with operationalisation expected within the next six months.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The elevation to a **strategic partnership** includes **MoUs** in fields such as **diplomatic training**, **higher education**, **cultural collaboration**, **innovation and technology**, and **search and rescue**.
 
• India continues to strongly support the **territorial integrity and sovereignty** of Cyprus, especially in the context of the 1974 division and the UN-maintained buffer zone.

questions.question: According to the recent Cabinet approval in May 2026, what will be the new maximum number of Judges in the Supreme Court of India (excluding the Chief Justice of India)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**37**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Union Cabinet** has approved a proposal to increase the **Judge strength of the Supreme Court of India** by **four**, raising the total from **33 to 37**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Cabinet, chaired by **Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi**, approved the introduction of **The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026** in Parliament.
 
• This bill amends **The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1956**.
 
• The amendment increases the number of Judges of the Supreme Court by **4**, elevating the present strength from **33** to a new strength of **37 (excluding the Chief Justice of India)**.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **37**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Article 124 (1)** of the Constitution of India originally provided for a Chief Justice of India and not more than **seven other Judges**.
 
• Historical increments in Judge strength (excluding CJI):
 
 
• **1956**: Maximum of **10** Judges.
 
• **1960**: Increased to **13** Judges.
 
• **1977**: Increased to **17** Judges.
 
• **1986**: Increased to **25** Judges.
 
• **2008**: Increased to **30** Judges.
 
• **2019**: Increased to **33** Judges.
 
 
 
• The expenditure on the salaries of Judges, supporting staff, and other facilities will be met from the **Consolidated Fund of India**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The major impact of this augmentation is to allow the **Supreme Court** to function more efficiently and effectively, ensuring **speedy justice**.

questions.question: The “Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity” (TRIPP), recently seen in the news, has been associated with a proposed peace initiative involving:

options.text: United States of America and Iran

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement I:** The **“Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity (TRIPP)”** is a U.S.-brokered peace and connectivity initiative associated with a transit corridor agreement between **Azerbaijan and Armenia**. It aims to establish a transport link connecting Azerbaijan with its Nakhchivan exclave through Armenian territory as part of a broader South Caucasus peace framework. Hence, **Statement I is correct. **
 
• **Statement II:** The **TRIPP initiative is not related to Ukraine and Russia**. The Russia–Ukraine conflict is a separate geopolitical issue involving Eastern Europe, whereas TRIPP is a South Caucasus connectivity and peace corridor project. Hence, **Statement II is incorrect. **
 
• **Statement III:** The initiative is also not connected to **Israel–Palestine negotiations**, which involve West Asian peace efforts under a different geopolitical framework. Hence, **Statement III is incorrect. **
 
• **Statement IV:** The TRIPP is not associated with the **United States–Iran relationship**, which involves nuclear negotiations and regional security issues distinct from the Armenia–Azerbaijan peace corridor. Hence, **Statement IV is incorrect. **
 
• **Therefore, only Statement I is correct. **
 
• 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **TRIPP (Trump Route for International Peace and Prosperity)** was announced as part of a U.S.-mediated agreement between **Armenia and Azerbaijan in 2025**, aimed at reopening transport connectivity in the **South Caucasus region**.
 
• The corridor is intended to connect mainland **Azerbaijan with its Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic** through southern Armenia, enhancing regional trade and connectivity.
 
• The initiative is seen as a major geopolitical development reducing long-standing regional tensions in the **Nagorno-Karabakh conflict zone** and shifting influence dynamics in the South Caucasus.

questions.question: Between which two cities have scientists mapped a nearly 200-kilometre-long underground palaeo-channel that could act as a massive natural aquifer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Prayagraj and Kanpur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Scientists have discovered a **200-kilometre-long underground palaeo-channel** between **Prayagraj and Kanpur** in **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• This discovery points to an ancient river system beneath the **Ganga-Yamuna Doab** that could serve as a massive natural aquifer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The remnant of the extinct river system was mapped along a nearly **200 km stretch** entirely between **Prayagraj and Kanpur**. Hence, **Option 2** is correct.
 
• The channel is buried **10 to 15 metres** below the surface and is **four to five kilometres wide**, making it comparable to major rivers like the **Ganga** and **Yamuna**.
 
• Scientists from the **Council of Scientific and Industrial Research-National Geophysical Research Institute (CSIR-NGRI)**, Hyderabad, made this discovery.
 
• The depth and base level of this palaeo-channel are similar to those of the Ganga and Yamuna, leading scientists to believe it may represent an **independent third river system**, rather than just an abandoned river channel.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Technology Used:** The mapping was done utilizing advanced **heliborne transient electromagnetic technology (H-TEM)** and confirmatory ground drilling.
 
• **New Development:** Since heliborne surveys are obstructed in urban areas like Prayagraj, **CSIR-NGRI** is developing **electrical-field vector resistivity imaging (EVRI)** technology to image deep underground in such terrains.
 
• **Collaborative Effort:** A tripartite agreement between the **National Mission for Clean Ganga (NMCG)**, the **Central Ground Water Board (CGWB)**, and **CSIR-NGRI** led to the detailed survey that established the 200km length.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Groundwater Significance:** Amid declining groundwater levels in the Gangetic plains, this channel could act as a massive natural aquifer. Six sites have been identified for **artificial groundwater recharge**, which could replenish the drying aquifers of the Ganga and Yamuna.
 
• **Saraswati Debate:** The discovery has reignited discussions around the mythical **Saraswati river**, as the palaeo-channel lies in the same geographical area mentioned in Vedic literature, though scientists emphasize the need for further investigation before confirming this link.

questions.question: How many times has Nepali guide Kami Rita Sherpa successfully scaled Mount Everest, setting a new record in May 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**32 times**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Two renowned **Nepali guides** have successfully scaled **Mount Everest**, establishing new historical records.
 
• **Kami Rita Sherpa** broke his own record by reaching the summit for the **32nd time**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kami Rita Sherpa**, widely known as the **“Everest Man”**, scaled **Mount Everest** for a record-breaking **32nd time**, surpassing his own previous record set last year.
 
• He accomplished his first summit of the world's highest mountain in **1994** while working for a commercial expedition.
 
• **Other options explained:**
 
• **11 times:** This is the women's record set by **Lhakpa Sherpa**, known as the **“Mountain Queen”**.
 
• **19 times:** This is the record held by British guide **Kenton Cool** among non-Sherpa climbers.
 
• **15 times:** This is the number of climbs accomplished by American climbers **Dave Hahn** and **Garrett Madison**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lhakpa Sherpa** first stood on top of Everest in **2000**, becoming the first Nepali woman to successfully summit and descend the peak.
 
• The height of the peak is mentioned as **8,849 metres (29,032ft)**.
 
• **Nepal** issued a record **492 Everest permits** this year for the March-May climbing season.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **Kami Rita** was born in **Thame village** in **Solukhumbu district**, the same village as **Tenzing Norgay**.
 
• **Tenzing Norgay** and **Edmund Hillary** were the first to successfully climb Mount Everest in **1953**.

questions.question: Who has been appointed as the new deputy governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) for a three-year term in May 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rohit Jain**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Rohit Jain** has been appointed as the new deputy governor of the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** for a three-year term.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian government has appointed **Rohit Jain** as the new deputy governor of the **Reserve Bank of India**.
 
• His term will take effect from **May 3** and will last for a period of **three years**.
 
• Prior to this elevation, **Jain** was serving as an **executive director** at the central bank.
 
• He takes over from **T Rabi Sankar**, who recently retired late last month after completing his tenure at the **RBI**.
 
• Other options like **Swaminathan J**, **Poonam Gupta**, and **S C Murmu** are the other three current deputy governors of the **RBI**, making them incorrect for this specific new appointment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• According to the **RBI Act, 1934**, the central bank should have a total of **four deputy governors**.
 
• The statutory structure requires two deputy governors from within the ranks, one commercial banker, and an economist to head the monetary policy department.
 
• Former deputy governor **T Rabi Sankar** was initially appointed in **September 2021** for three years and had received subsequent extensions in **2024** and **2025**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The appointment of **Rohit Jain** maintains the structural mandate of the **RBI**'s top leadership following the retirement of his predecessor.

questions.question: The Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel (NGOPV) 'Sanghmitra', launched in May 2026, is named after the daughter of which historical figure?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**King Ashoka**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• On **20 May 2026**, the Indian Navy launched **Yard 3039 (Sanghmitra)**, a **Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessel (NGOPV)**, at **M/s GRSE, Kolkata**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The ship is named **'Sanghmitra'** after the daughter of **King Ashoka**, deriving its name from India's rich heritage.
 
• The vessel was launched by **Mrs Sarita Vatsayan** in the presence of **VAdm Sanjay Vatsayan**, Vice Chief of the Naval Staff.
 
• The crest design of **Sanghmitra** features the constellation of **Ursa Major** and a **red and white lighthouse**.
 
• It is the latest addition to the Indian Navy's fleet of **Next Generation Offshore Patrol Vessels (NGOPVs)** designed for multi-domain operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The Ministry of Defence is overseeing the construction of **11 NGOPVs** concurrently across two shipyards: **GSL (Goa)** and **GRSE (Kolkata)**.
 
• These ships are intended for various roles, including **surveillance**, **search and rescue**, **protection of offshore assets**, **Humanitarian Assistance and Disaster Relief (HADR)**, and **anti-piracy** missions.
 
• The event was conducted with **full naval honours**, marking a step forward in the Navy's transition toward **indigenous shipbuilding**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The project aligns with the Government of India’s visions of **Aatmanirbhar Bharat** and the **Make in India** initiative.
 
• The ships will augment the existing fleet of **Offshore Patrol Vessels (OPVs)** and **Naval Offshore Patrol Vessels (NOPVs)** for enhanced maritime security in the Indian area of interest.

questions.question: During the 12th round of India-Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IK CEPA) upgrade negotiations held in May 2026, it was decided to constitute sub-groups to expand cooperation in which specific areas?

options.text: Digital trade, supply chain cooperation, and strategic industrial cooperation
Civil aviation, shipping, and road transport

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Digital trade, supply chain cooperation, and strategic industrial cooperation**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **12th round** of the **India-Korea Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IK CEPA)** upgrade negotiations was held in **New Delhi** from **25–27 May 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• During this round, both countries decided to constitute **sub-groups** specifically to discuss and expand cooperation in the areas of **digital trade**, **supply chain cooperation**, and **strategic industrial cooperation**. Hence, Option 2 is correct.
 
• The negotiations were co-chaired by **Ms. Kapil Chaudhary** (Joint Secretary, Department of Commerce, India) and **Mr. Park Geun-oh** (Director General for Trade Agreement Policy, Republic of Korea).
 
• The discussions included various tracks such as **Trade in Goods (TiG)**, **Trade in Services (TiS)**, **Rules of Origin (RoO)**, **Investment**, and **Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS)** standards.
 
• Both sides acknowledged the rising **bilateral trade deficit** for India since the CEPA came into force in **2010** and agreed to address this within the upgrade framework.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The current negotiations are a result of the **Joint Declaration** signed on **20 April 2026** by India's Union Minister **Shri Piyush Goyal** and Korean Trade Minister **Mr. Yeo Han-koo**.
 
• The upgrade talks align with the **"Futuristic Partnership"** envisioned by **Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi** and the President of the Republic of Korea, **Mr. Lee Jae-myung**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The primary objective of these negotiations is to achieve a **modernised** and **mutually beneficial agreement** in a **time-bound manner**.
 
• The **India-Korea CEPA** originally came into force in **2010**, and the upgrade aims for **balanced bilateral trade**.

questions.question: Maj Gen (Retd) Bhuvan Chandra Khanduri, who passed away in May 2026, served as the Chief Minister of which state?

• BC Khanduri was a prominent political figure who served as the Chief Minister of Uttarakhand.

 __

questions.question: Which of the following statements about the India-Netherlands Joint Statement (May 2026) is INCORRECT?

options.text: The leaders decided to elevate bilateral relations to a 'Strategic Partnership' and adopted a Strategic Partnership Roadmap for 2026-2030.
The Netherlands decided to join the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI) and co-lead the Capacity Building & Resource Sharing pillar.
A Memorandum of Understanding was signed between Reliance Industries and ASML to support a semiconductor Fab in Dholera.
A Letter of Intent was signed for Technical Cooperation with regards to the Kalpasar Project in Gujarat.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A Memorandum of Understanding was signed between Reliance Industries and ASML to support a semiconductor Fab in Dholera.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** paid an official visit to the **Netherlands** on **16-17 May 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between **TATA Electronics** (and not Reliance Industries) and **ASML** to support a semiconductor Fab in **Dholera**. Hence, the statement "A Memorandum of Understanding was signed between Reliance Industries and ASML to support a semiconductor Fab in Dholera" is **incorrect**.
 
• The leaders decided to elevate bilateral relations to a **'Strategic Partnership'** and adopted a **Strategic Partnership Roadmap (2026-2030)**. Hence, the statement is **correct**.
 
• The **Netherlands** decided to join the **Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative (IPOI)** and co-lead the **Capacity Building & Resource Sharing** pillar. Hence, the statement is **correct**.
 
• A Letter of Intent was signed between the **Ministry of Jal Shakti** of India and the **Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management** of the Netherlands for Technical Cooperation regarding the **Kalpasar Project** in **Gujarat**. Hence, the statement is **correct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• This was Prime Minister **Modi’s second visit** to the Netherlands, held at the invitation of the Prime Minister of the Netherlands, **Mr. Rob Jetten**.
 
• The leaders highlighted strong trade growth, with the **Netherlands** serving as a gateway to Europe, particularly via the **Rotterdam Port**.
 
• An agreement was also signed for the **restitution of Chola Copper Plates**.
 
• An Indo-Dutch Center of Excellence for **Flowers** is being established in **West Tripura**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• A total of around **17 agreements/MoUs** were signed during the visit across various sectors, including **critical minerals, green hydrogen, higher education,** and **customs**.

questions.question: Who among the following have been appointed as the new **Executive Directors** of **Central Depository Services Limited (CDSL)** following **SEBI's** approval in May 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Mahajan and Nayana Ovalekar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)** has approved the appointment of **Amit Mahajan** and **Nayana Ovalekar** as **executive directors** on the board of **Central Depository Services Limited (CDSL)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amit Mahajan** has been appointed to oversee **Vertical 1**, which encompasses **Critical Operations**.
 
• **Nayana Ovalekar** will lead **Vertical 2**, which covers **Regulatory, Compliance, Risk Management, and Investor Grievances**.
 
• According to **SEBI’s** approval letters issued on May 25, 2026, the appointments will take effect from their **respective joining dates**.
 
• These appointments remain subject to **ratification by the shareholders** of **CDSL**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL)** is a key **market infrastructure institution** that facilitates the holding and exchange of securities in electronic form.
 
• **SEBI (Securities and Exchange Board of India)** is the statutory **regulatory body** for the Indian capital markets.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The division of roles into specific **Verticals** (Critical Operations vs. Regulatory/Compliance) is intended to streamline the **governance** and **operational efficiency** of the depository.
